title: PROD-READINESS-01 — Document Storage Investigation & Target Design (not applied to production)

runtimeKeyConfirmed.effectiveFallbackPath: /opt/reporting/publish/App_Data/documents (INSIDE the replaced publish dir => silent loss on every deploy)
runtimeKeyConfirmed.separateKey: FileStorageOptions.EmployeeServiceFinalDocumentsPath (distinct consumer: employee-service final docs; already set in prod to /var/lib/reporting/employee-service-requests/final-documents, OUTSIDE publish)
runtimeKeyConfirmed.pathTraversalGuard: LocalFileStorage.cs:17-18 SegmentPattern regex ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ on every key segment; identifiers-only storage keys (no original filename in path)

currentProductionExposure.interpretation: Client/Project Document Service migrations are NOT yet applied in production (prod=30 migrations, ce166662, pre-CPW). Therefore no documents exist to lose TODAY; the blocker is prospective: it triggers the first time the candidate (with the document feature) is deployed AND a document is uploaded, unless DocumentsRootPath is set to a persistent path outside publish.

targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.rationale: Mirrors the proven TEST pattern /var/lib/reporting-test/documents; outside /opt/reporting/publish so nginx/systemd/publish replacement never touches it; on the same disk (53G free).
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.mode: 2750 (or 0750) — service RW, not world-readable, not served by nginx (nginx root is /opt/reporting/reporting-frontend/dist only)
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.envChange: add FileStorage__DocumentsRootPath=/var/lib/reporting/documents to /etc/reporting-api.env (config-only; NO code change, NO migration)
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.migrationOfExistingFiles: N/A for first deploy (0 existing documents); if any future App_Data/documents exists, rsync -a into new root then verify md5 before switching
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.verificationBeforeAfter: empty→populate via upload; md5 of stored blob compared pre/post redeploy and pre/post restart
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.rollbackForStorage: storage path is independent of app artifact; rolling back the app publish does NOT delete /var/lib/reporting/documents; env line can be removed to revert (but then feature falls back — so keep the dir persistent regardless)
targetDesign_NOT_APPLIED_TO_PROD.preventFutureDeployDeletion: root is outside publish; deploy replaces only /opt/reporting/publish and /opt/reporting/reporting-frontend/dist — neither contains /var/lib/reporting/documents

verdictBeforeRehearsal: PROD-READINESS-01 = OPEN until proven on isolated rehearsal (upload/download/version/archive/restore/metadata + redeploy-no-loss + restart-no-loss with matching blob hashes).
